final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT P.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS c FROM Examination E JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = E.ID GROUP BY P.SEX), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.sex AS sex, s1.c AS c, s1.c * 1.0 / s2.t AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.sex AS sex, s3.c AS c, s3.share AS share, s3.c - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c > s4.a) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(share), AVG(diff) FROM s5
